Bogged Finance on BNB Chain was exploited on May 22, 2021, via a flash-loan-enabled inflation of staking rewards. The attacker drained over $3 million to $3.6 million in BNB from the protocol by manipulating the reward logic in the BOG token contract. A mismatch between the BOG token’s transfer-fee and staking-reward logic enabled repeated self-transfers to grant excess staking rewards, outpacing the transfer fee deducted and thus inflating profit. This arithmetic and logic flaw allowed a flash-loan-boosted attacker to drain liquidity from the protocol’s pool.
